title: Tag a structural framing element in a plan view
task: Tag a structural framing element in a plan view with IndependentTag.Create, placing the tag in an Engineering (structural) ViewPlan at the element's level where framing is visible after doc.Regenerate. Covers annotation tags.

pitfalls.symptom: IndependentTag.Create throws that the element is not visible in the view, or the tag comes out empty.
pitfalls.cause: A tag can only be placed where the element is actually visible; a just-created framing element shows in a structural-discipline plan and only after the document is regenerated.
pitfalls.fix: Call doc.Regenerate() after creating the element, and place the tag in an Engineering (structural) ViewPlan at the element's level (fall back to a FloorPlan at that level).

pitfalls.symptom: A task search 'tag a structural framing beam in a view' surfaces IndependentTag properties (RotationAngle, TagOrientation, TagHeadPosition) above the IndependentTag.Create method.
pitfalls.cause: The Create method ranks below the tag's own properties for tagging intent (connector issue #341-adjacent).
pitfalls.fix: Name IndependentTag.Create in the search; its signature is (Document, ElementId tagTypeId, ElementId ownerViewId, Reference, bool addLeader, TagOrientation, XYZ tagHeadPoint).
